title: os validate refuses an app menu entry naming the built-in sys_task or sys_note unless it carries requiresObject
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2uhJ1AYNPw5TUSVS

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. Source: fleet (found by the #36944 card thread while building `examples/app-starter`, PR #37399).

Grading: area:build · Bug · Impeded × builders (workaround exists: add `requiresObject` to the entry; the error does not name it) → p2 · reach: `os validate` measured on the #36944 branch (an entry `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_task' }` without `requiresObject` fails) · evidence: measured + read.

## What is wrong

- The `sys_task` docblock (`packages/platform-objects/src/work/sys-task.object.ts` lines ~10-14) tells an app to "put tasks in its menu with a `type: 'object'` navigation entry naming `sys_task` instead of declaring its own task object". `sys_note` has no such sentence, but the check refuses it the same way (measured on the #36944 branch).
- The stack cross-reference check refuses exactly that entry: `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` ~6436-6445 pushes `App '<app>' navigation references object 'sys_task' which is not defined in objects.` unless the entry sets `requiresObject`.
- The neighbouring checks in the same file already exempt platform objects with `isPlatformObjectName` (seed data ~4534, ~4578; child lists ~4725). The navigation check is the one that does not.

## Why it matters

Every app that follows the platform docs to put 任务/备忘 in its menu (the starter app #36944, the CLI blank template #36945, any AI-written app reading the docblock or the platform catalog) hits a refusal whose message points at the wrong fix ("not defined in objects" invites declaring a package copy, which the starter epic forbids).

## Open question for the dispatcher (not decided here)

Two shapes, pick by reading the requiresObject semantics (runtime hides the entry when the object is absent; the approvals inbox entry is taught with `requiresObject`, closed card #33235):
- A. exempt always-present platform objects (or `isPlatformObjectName`) in the navigation check, like the seed and child checks; or
- B. keep the refusal and make the docblocks (and the platform catalog skill text) teach `requiresObject`, with the error naming it.
A widens the accept set of `os validate` (Clause-② reading owed); B is text plus an error message. If the choice turns out to be a product call, route it to the decision box.

## Who acts

The `domain:spec` lane (the check lives in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`); #36945 will meet it next.

Dedupe: `"navigation references object"` → 7 hits (open: #36944, #35134, neither about this check); `requiresObject platform` → 63 hits, none open on this check (closed #33235 is the approvals skill text); `sys_task navigation` → #36944, #35947 (epic, paused). No open card covers it.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#36944.
